bottom:
Create a natural, editorial-quality 1:1 square background photograph for a Thai insurance agent's Facebook post.

Scene:
A Thai father reading to his daughter at bedtime

Absolute rules:
- NO text, letters, numbers or words, and NO logos, watermarks, signatures or user-interface elements anywhere in the image.
- Keep the bottom half of the frame calm and uncluttered — simple tones, no busy detail.
- Avoid: hospital gore, blood, injuries, needles close-up; funerals, coffins, graves, grieving at a deathbed; piles of cash, gold, gambling imagery; company logos, insurer branding, documents with readable writing; rigid posing, generic corporate stock photography, plastic skin, sterile showroom lighting.

Visual direction:
- Colour palette: deep navy blue shadows with warm sand and cream highlights.
- Thai people in a Thai setting; imperfect natural gestures, believable depth, soft natural light.
- Hopeful and reassuring rather than fearful.
- Thai headline text will be placed on top of the image later, so leave room to breathe.
